newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan interbank rate ends up, but off highs.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan interbank rate ends up, but off highs.

text.p: Taiwan's interbank rate closed firmer on Thursday but off its intra-day high of 5.502 percent and dealers expected the rate to move around the current level in the near term.

The overnight interbank rate breached the central bank's 5.50 percent threshold at one point but soon slid back to end at 5.495, compared with Wednesday's 5.473 close. The 30-day commercial paper closed at 5.5 percent against 5.35.
The money rates were likely to hover around the current level unless the central bank changed its relatively loose monetary policy, dealers said.
Sentiment in the bond market remained quiet, with players stepping to the sidelines. Recent bull run in the stock market had triggered selling in early trade.
The 10-year 86/4 government bond yield was traded at 6.175 earlier.
